wrap_function_retry_cuda_oom: wrap a pytorch function with retry_if_cuda_oom to automatically retry on CUDA out of memory errors
use_ignore_torch_cuda_oom_context: use the _ignore_torch_cuda_oom context manager to silently catch and ignore CUDA OOM exceptions in a code block
handle_cuda_oom_with_decorator: handle CUDA out of memory errors by decorating a stateless torch function with retry_if_cuda_oom
fallback_to_cpu_on_oom: fallback to CPU execution when CUDA OOM persists by using retry_if_cuda_oom which moves inputs to CPU
empty_cuda_cache_and_retry: empty the CUDA cache and retry a function call when encountering a CUDA out of memory error
